# Exposure coding {#sec-exposure} ::: {.callout-important} ## AI-generated — not for publication The code and prose in this book were written by an AI agent under human direction; they have not been verified line by line and must not be published or cited as-is. ::: ::: {.callout-warning} ## Preliminary & unvetted analysis Exploratory analysis. Exposure counts were hand-coded from import scripts and source papers and are still being checked; see the confidence column in `metadata/exposure_design.csv`. ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) library(here) i_am("notebooks/02-exposure-coding.qmd") # _quarto.yml would otherwise make notebooks/ the root d <- readRDS(here("cache", "01_peekbank_novel.rds")) design <- read_csv(here("metadata", "exposure_design.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) external <- read_csv(here("metadata", "external_teaching.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) word_recode <- read_csv(here("metadata", "novel_words.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) ``` ::: Every trial in a novel-word dataset gets a **role**. Then, for each trial whose target is a novel word, we count how many times that word was heard *before* this trial, split by type of exposure: * **teaching**: the word labels its referent before testing (role `teaching` or `teaching_incidental`) * **ME**: a referent-selection trial with a novel and a familiar object, or a new word against a previously taught object (role `test_me`) * **test**: an earlier test trial with this word as the target (roles `test_nn`, `test_nf`, `test_untaught`) Teaching that happened outside the imported trials (learning videos, habituation, isolated teaching trials that Peekbank did not import) is added from `metadata/external_teaching.csv`. Rows there match on dataset, a regex on condition, the word (`*` = any), and optionally `trial_order`. The `trial_order` key is for designs where teaching is interleaved with tests in a fixed order (`reflook_socword`). ## Trial table Peekbank links trials to administrations only through the timepoint table, so we recover that link first. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} stim <- d$stimuli |> select(stimulus_id, novelty = stimulus_novelty, label = english_stimulus_label) trial_admin <- d$aoi_timepoints |> distinct(administration_id, trial_id) trials <- d$trials |> filter(dataset_name %in% d$novel_datasets) |> select(trial_id, trial_order, trial_type_id, excluded, dataset_name) |> inner_join(trial_admin, by = "trial_id") |> left_join(d$trial_types |> select(trial_type_id, condition, full_phrase, full_phrase_language, target_id, distractor_id, vanilla_trial), by = "trial_type_id") |> left_join(stim |> rename(target_id = stimulus_id, target_novelty = novelty, target_label = label), by = "target_id") |> left_join(stim |> rename(distractor_id = stimulus_id, distractor_novelty = novelty, distractor_label = label), by = "distractor_id") |> left_join(d$administrations |> select(administration_id, subject_id, age), by = "administration_id") |> # recode generic novel labels (e.g. "novel" -> "deebo") left_join(word_recode |> select(dataset_name, target_label = original_label, target_word = word), by = c("dataset_name", "target_label")) |> left_join(word_recode |> select(dataset_name, distractor_label = original_label, distractor_word = word), by = c("dataset_name", "distractor_label")) |> mutate(target_label = coalesce(target_word, target_label), distractor_label = coalesce(distractor_word, distractor_label)) |> select(-target_word, -distractor_word) ``` ::: ## Roles Roles come from `exposure_design.csv`, keyed by dataset × condition × target novelty. `*` in the condition column matches any condition. Trials not listed there are `familiar` when both stimuli are familiar, and `uncoded` otherwise. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} design_exact <- design |> filter(condition != "*") design_any <- design |> filter(condition == "*") |> select(-condition) trials <- trials |> left_join(design_exact |> select(dataset_name, condition, target_novelty, role, confidence, needs_prior_session), by = c("dataset_name", "condition", "target_novelty")) |> left_join(design_any |> select(dataset_name, target_novelty, role_any = role, confidence_any = confidence), by = c("dataset_name", "target_novelty")) |> mutate(role = coalesce(role, role_any, if_else(target_novelty == "familiar" & distractor_novelty == "familiar", "familiar", "uncoded")), confidence = coalesce(confidence, confidence_any), needs_prior_session = coalesce(needs_prior_session, FALSE)) |> select(-role_any, -confidence_any) trials |> count(dataset_name, role) |> pivot_wider(names_from = role, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} trials |> filter(role == "uncoded") |> count(dataset_name, condition, target_novelty, distractor_novelty) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Which word does each trial expose? For most trials this is the target label. Training trials in `byers-heinlein_2022` and the medial trials in `fernald_marchman_2012` have a *familiar* target, and the novel word appears only in the phrase ("Do you see the dog on the walem?", "There's a baby on the deebo"). For those trials we find the dataset's novel words in `full_phrase`. We count tokens (repetitions within the phrase) where a phrase exists. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dataset_words <- trials |> filter(target_novelty == "novel") |> distinct(dataset_name, word = target_label) find_word <- function(phrase, words) { if (is.na(phrase)) return(NA_character_) hit <- words[str_detect(str_to_lower(phrase), paste0("\\b", str_to_lower(words), "\\b"))] if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1] } word_lists <- dataset_words |> summarise(words = list(word), .by = dataset_name) trials <- trials |> left_join(word_lists, by = "dataset_name") |> mutate(phrase_word = map2_chr(full_phrase, words, \(p, w) find_word(p, w %||% character()))) |> select(-words) |> mutate( exposed_word = case_when( role %in% c("teaching", "teaching_incidental") & target_novelty == "familiar" ~ phrase_word, target_novelty == "novel" ~ target_label, TRUE ~ NA_character_), # a medial trial that says "over there" does not label the novel object role = if_else(role == "teaching_incidental" & is.na(exposed_word), "familiar", role), exposure_type = case_when( role %in% c("teaching", "teaching_incidental") ~ "teaching", role == "test_me" ~ "me", role %in% c("test_nn", "test_nf", "test_untaught", "test_nn_incidental") ~ "test", TRUE ~ NA_character_), tokens = if_else(!is.na(exposed_word) & !is.na(full_phrase), str_count(str_to_lower(full_phrase), paste0("\\b", str_to_lower(coalesce(exposed_word, "")), "\\b")), NA_integer_)) trials |> filter(!is.na(exposure_type)) |> count(dataset_name, exposure_type, exposed_word) |> pivot_wider(names_from = exposure_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Missing trials Some administrations have gaps in `trial_order`: trials that were presented but are absent from Peekbank, presumably dropped at import for lack of usable gaze data. The sessions continue past the gaps, so the child still heard those trials. A missing teaching trial would undercount teaching. These designs use fixed trial lists, so we reconstruct each gap from *donor* administrations of the same dataset. A donor has the missing position, matches the gappy administration exactly (condition, target, distractor, phrase) at every position both have, and shares at least 80% of its trials. A gap is filled only when all donors agree on what was there. Gaps after an administration's last trial are not filled, because the session may have ended. Positions that are absent in *every* administration of a dataset (e.g. the breaks in `pomper_salientme`, or the un-imported teaching phase of `pomper_yumme` v5) are never filled. External teaching covers the latter. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} slots <- trials |> filter(role != "exclude") |> transmute(dataset_name, administration_id, trial_order, key = paste(condition, target_label, distractor_label, coalesce(str_squish(full_phrase), ""), sep = "|"), exposure_type, exposed_word, tokens) gaps <- slots |> summarise(hi = max(trial_order), .by = c(dataset_name, administration_id)) |> left_join(slots |> summarise(first = min(trial_order), .by = dataset_name), by = "dataset_name") |> mutate(trial_order = map2(first, hi, seq)) |> unnest(trial_order) |> select(dataset_name, administration_id, trial_order) |> anti_join(slots, by = c("dataset_name", "administration_id", "trial_order")) n_slots <- slots |> count(dataset_name, a = administration_id, name = "n_a") donors <- slots |> semi_join(distinct(gaps, dataset_name, administration_id), by = c("dataset_name", "administration_id")) |> select(dataset_name, a = administration_id, trial_order, key_a = key) |> inner_join(slots |> select(dataset_name, b = administration_id, trial_order, key_b = key), by = c("dataset_name", "trial_order"), relationship = "many-to-many") |> filter(a != b) |> summarise(shared = n(), mismatches = sum(key_a != key_b), .by = c(dataset_name, a, b)) |> left_join(n_slots, by = c("dataset_name", "a")) |> filter(mismatches == 0, shared >= .8 * n_a) reconstructed <- gaps |> rename(a = administration_id) |> inner_join(donors |> select(dataset_name, a, b), by = c("dataset_name", "a"), relationship = "many-to-many") |> inner_join(slots |> rename(b = administration_id), by = c("dataset_name", "b", "trial_order")) |> summarise(n_donors = n_distinct(b), n_keys = n_distinct(key), across(c(key, exposure_type, exposed_word, tokens), first), .by = c(dataset_name, a, trial_order)) |> rename(administration_id = a) gaps |> left_join(reconstructed, by = c("dataset_name", "administration_id", "trial_order")) |> mutate(status = case_when(is.na(n_donors) ~ "no_donor", n_keys > 1 ~ "ambiguous", !is.na(exposure_type) ~ paste0("filled_", exposure_type), TRUE ~ "filled_other")) |> count(dataset_name, status) |> pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} reconstructed <- reconstructed |> filter(n_keys == 1, !is.na(exposure_type), !is.na(exposed_word)) ``` ::: Unfilled gaps mean teaching can still be undercounted. `teaching_observed` (below) counts only trials present in Peekbank, as a sensitivity check. ## Counting prior exposures For each trial with a novel target word, we count exposures to that word on trials that came earlier in the same administration (by `trial_order`), and on all of the same child's *earlier* administrations in the same dataset. Both count toward `teaching`. The split is kept (`*_session` vs `*_prev`), because the gap between sessions ranges from about a week to 6 months across datasets. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} admin_info <- trials |> distinct(administration_id, subject_id, age) events <- trials |> filter(!is.na(exposure_type), !is.na(exposed_word)) |> select(dataset_name, subject_id, administration_id, age, trial_order, word = exposed_word, exposure_type, tokens) |> mutate(reconstructed = FALSE) |> bind_rows(reconstructed |> left_join(admin_info, by = "administration_id") |> select(dataset_name, subject_id, administration_id, age, trial_order, word = exposed_word, exposure_type, tokens) |> mutate(reconstructed = TRUE)) # order administrations within child admin_order <- trials |> distinct(dataset_name, subject_id, administration_id, age) |> arrange(dataset_name, subject_id, age, administration_id) |> mutate(session = row_number(), .by = c(dataset_name, subject_id)) |> select(administration_id, session) events <- events |> left_join(admin_order, by = "administration_id") targets <- trials |> filter(target_novelty == "novel") |> left_join(admin_order, by = "administration_id") |> select(trial_id, administration_id, dataset_name, subject_id, session, trial_order, needs_prior_session, word = target_label, distractor_word = distractor_label) count_prior <- function(targets, events, word_col) { targets |> select(trial_id, dataset_name, subject_id, session, trial_order, word = all_of(word_col)) |> inner_join(events |> rename(ev_session = session, ev_order = trial_order), by = c("dataset_name", "subject_id", "word"), relationship = "many-to-many") |> mutate(when = case_when(ev_session == session & ev_order < trial_order ~ "session", ev_session < session ~ "prev", TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |> filter(!is.na(when)) |> count(trial_id, exposure_type, when) |> pivot_wider(names_from = c(exposure_type, when), values_from = n, names_glue = "{exposure_type}_{when}") } prior <- count_prior(targets, events, "word") # teaching from trials present in Peekbank only (no reconstructed trials) prior_observed <- count_prior(targets, events |> filter(!reconstructed, exposure_type == "teaching"), "word") |> rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_observed"), -trial_id) # the same counts for the distractor word (on N-N trials it may also have been taught) prior_distractor <- count_prior(targets, events, "distractor_word") |> rename_with(~ paste0("distractor_", .x), -trial_id) exposure_cols <- c("teaching_session", "teaching_prev", "me_session", "me_prev", "test_session", "test_prev") observed_cols <- c("teaching_session_observed", "teaching_prev_observed") exposures <- targets |> select(trial_id, needs_prior_session, word, distractor_word) |> left_join(prior, by = "trial_id") |> left_join(prior_observed, by = "trial_id") |> (\(x) { for (col in setdiff(c(exposure_cols, observed_cols), names(x))) x[[col]] <- NA_integer_; x })() |> mutate(across(all_of(c(exposure_cols, observed_cols)), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L))) |> left_join(prior_distractor |> select(trial_id, any_of("distractor_teaching_session")), by = "trial_id") if (!"distractor_teaching_session" %in% names(exposures)) exposures$distractor_teaching_session <- NA_integer_ exposures <- exposures |> mutate(distractor_teaching_session = replace_na(distractor_teaching_session, 0L)) ``` ::: ### External teaching ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} external ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ext_match <- trials |> filter(target_novelty == "novel") |> select(trial_id, dataset_name, condition, trial_order, word = target_label) |> inner_join(external, by = "dataset_name", relationship = "many-to-many") |> filter(str_detect(condition, condition_regex), word.y == "*" | word.x == word.y, is.na(trial_order.y) | trial_order.x == trial_order.y) |> select(trial_id, teaching_external = teaching_events, external_confidence = confidence) stopifnot(!any(duplicated(ext_match$trial_id))) exposures <- exposures |> left_join(ext_match, by = "trial_id") |> mutate( has_external = trial_id %in% ext_match$trial_id, teaching_external = if_else(has_external, teaching_external, 0), # teaching = this session + earlier sessions of the same child + external (outside the # imported trials); NA when the external count is not yet coded teaching = teaching_session + teaching_prev + teaching_external, teaching_observed = teaching_session_observed + teaching_prev_observed + teaching_external, # tests that rely on teaching in an earlier session (fernald_totlot ylearn at 21 months, # fernald_marchman_2012 FerretRetention) are uncoded when that session is not in Peekbank across(c(teaching, teaching_observed), ~ if_else(needs_prior_session & teaching_prev == 0, NA_real_, .x)), total_exposures = teaching + me_session + me_prev + test_session + test_prev) |> select(-needs_prior_session) ``` ::: How much does reconstruction change teaching on N–N tests? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} exposures |> inner_join(trials |> filter(role == "test_nn") |> select(trial_id, dataset_name), by = "trial_id") |> summarise(n_trials = n(), changed = sum(teaching != teaching_observed, na.rm = TRUE), mean_added = mean(teaching - teaching_observed, na.rm = TRUE), uncoded_no_prior_session = sum(is.na(teaching) & has_external == FALSE), .by = dataset_name) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Timing Teaching is entangled with *when* a test happens: tests after one exposure tend to come right after it and early in the session, tests after more exposures come later. To control for this in @sec-exposure-age, we record: * `session_trials`: the last `trial_order` of the administration, for relative trial position * `trials_since_teaching`: trials since the word was last taught *in this session* (observed or reconstructed teaching trials). NA when all of the word's teaching happened outside the imported trials or in an earlier session. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} session_length <- trials |> summarise(session_trials = max(trial_order), .by = administration_id) since_teaching <- targets |> select(trial_id, dataset_name, subject_id, session, trial_order, word) |> inner_join(events |> filter(exposure_type == "teaching") |> select(dataset_name, subject_id, session, word, ev_order = trial_order), by = c("dataset_name", "subject_id", "session", "word"), relationship = "many-to-many") |> filter(ev_order < trial_order) |> summarise(trials_since_teaching = min(trial_order - ev_order), .by = trial_id) ``` ::: ## Result Teaching counts on N–N test trials by dataset: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} trial_exposures <- trials |> filter(target_novelty == "novel") |> select(trial_id, administration_id, subject_id, dataset_name, age, trial_order, condition, role, confidence, excluded, full_phrase_language, target_label, distractor_label, distractor_novelty) |> left_join(exposures |> select(-word, -distractor_word), by = "trial_id") |> left_join(session_length, by = "administration_id") |> left_join(since_teaching, by = "trial_id") trial_exposures |> filter(role == "test_nn") |> group_by(dataset_name) |> summarise(n_trials = n(), teaching_coded = all(!is.na(teaching)), teaching = paste(sort(unique(teaching)), collapse = ", "), teaching_prev = paste(sort(unique(teaching_prev)), collapse = ", "), me = paste(sort(unique(me_session)), collapse = ", "), prior_tests = paste(range(test_session), collapse = "-")) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} saveRDS(trial_exposures, here("cache", "02_trial_exposures.rds")) ``` :::
